sources.title: 🔸 Shyvana / Tremble before the power of a dragon 🔸

passive.name: Scalemail
passive.text: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

spells.name: Emberstrike
spells.text: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.

spells.name: Inferno Aegis
spells.text: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates. While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.

spells.name: Molten Burst
spells.text: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.text: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

damage.value: Shyvana has sustained ability damage and burst potential.

archetype.value: Shyvana plays as a durable hybrid fighter in melee and dragon forms.

axis.value: Shyvana is strong in extended fights.

winCondition.value: Shyvana wins through objective control, efficient farming, and late-game impact.

spikes.why: Shyvana gains durability, offensive power, and ability haste to use her spells more often.
